output.description: SDL render output backend (e.g., surface, opengl, openglshaders, ttf, sdl2, xvid). See DOSBox-X docs for full list.

render_aspect.description: Enable aspect ratio correction for rendering.

machine.description: Emulated video adapter/machine type (e.g., vgaonly, svga_s3, pc98, cga, ega, tandy). Must match documented valid choices.

cpu_core.description: CPU core type (auto, normal, full, dynamic, simple). See DOSBox-X documentation.

cpu_cycles.description: Emulated CPU cycles (auto, fixed, mixed). If numeric, must be integer percentage (e.g., '7500').

autoexec_lines.description: List of commands to execute on startup in the [autoexec] section. Each item is one command line.

mixer_nomixer.description: Disable internal DOS mixer (useful for avoiding audio conflicts).

midi_device.description: MIDI output device (none, mt32, OPL2, OPL3, generic).

serial1_type.description: Serial port 1 configuration: none, real, direct, pipe.

parallel1_type.description: Parallel port 1 configuration: none, direct, lpt1.
